The IaC template is the intended state, so this is an out-of-band configuration change. Its effects are visible in the logs. Average duration rose and the 01:38 bin shows a max duration of about 2.2 s, close to the 3 s timeout. Peak memory is about 103 MB, under the 128 MB limit, so there is no OOM yet, but the function is at risk of timeouts. The CrudApi, Uploader and Compression functions match the IaC, and the IAM roles show no permission issue.
